description: The robotics industry is on the cusp of its own “GPT” moment, catalyzed by transformative research advances. Enter Memo, the first general-intelligence personal robot, focused on taking on your chores to give back your time. Sarah Guo sits down with Tony Zhao and Cheng Chi, co-founders of Sunday Robotics, to discuss the state of AI robotics. Tony and Cheng speak to the challenges they faced while developing their technology, the innovative glove system employed to scale real-world data collectio…
classificationReason: Directly examines home robots, real-world data collection, diffusion policies, ACT, ALOHA, imitation learning, design, deployment, and scaling.
qualityReason: Extended founder interview with sustained discussion of diffusion policy, ACT/ALOHA, imitation learning, data-collection hardware, trajectory counts, quality control, failure modes, costs, deployment constraints, and concrete demonstrations.
